components.css: .ds-source{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--docs-radius);background:var(--docs-code-bg);color:var(--docs-code-text);font-family:var(--docs-font-sans);line-height:1.65}.ds-source-header{display:flex;min-height:44px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:4px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid #293852;color:var(--docs-code-muted);font-size:12px}.ds-source-header button{min-height:36px;padding:4px 8px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:var(--docs-code-text);font-family:var(--docs-font-sans);font-size:12px;line-height:1.65;cursor:pointer}.ds-source-header button:hover{border-color:#52617a}.ds-source-header button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--docs-focus);outline-offset:3px}.ds-source pre{max-height:560px;margin:0;overflow:auto;padding:20px;font-family:var(--docs-font-mono);font-size:13px;line-height:1.75;tab-size:2;scrollbar-color:#52617a transparent}.ds-source pre:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--docs-focus);outline-offset:-3px}.ds-source code{font:inherit}@media(max-width:760px){.ds-source pre{padding:16px;font-size:12px}}

narrative.overview:
This is the documentation's reading expression of Sectile's established white, ink, and violet world. Open paper carries explanations; ruled links, static example galleries, runnable previews, and source blocks make behavior inspectable. The mood is a clean Read surface.

This contract belongs to the private Vue/Vite documentation package. Its reading shell, geometry, preview styling, and source components extend the root design system locally. The library's headless components leave application presentation with the consumer. Root `DESIGN.md` remains the authority for the broader brand and landing surface.
keyCharacteristics: White reading canvas with ink copy and quiet rules.
Restrained violet for actions, navigation selection, and focus.
Sans-serif explanation with monospace code and live values.
Flat previews and source blocks with perimeter-defined geometry.
Distinct Vue and DOM navigation contexts.

rules.name: The Violet Means Action Rule
rules.body: Use violet for links, actions, selected navigation, checked state, and visible keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Code Is Mono Rule
rules.body: Keep code and emitted values in monospace, and explanatory copy in the sans-serif reading voice.

rules.name: The Paper Before Panels Rule
rules.body: Use open paper and ruled rows for guidance; bounded containers hold examples and source.

dos: Do keep this contract scoped to the documentation reading shell and examples.
Do preserve paper, ink, restrained violet, and explicit keyboard focus.
Do use ruled links for guidance and bounded previews for runnable behavior.
Do identify whether preview styling is supplied by the docs or shown source.
donts: Don't prescribe application styling through the headless library's public contract.
